note: Same decomposition scaled by `q`: `δ₂ = s₀/q`, `δ₁(n) = β(n-c)/(qQ)`, integer part `a n + c₀` (book `aj+c`), written directly in `n`; mod 1 becomes the periodicity of `sin²(π·)` handled in `hterm`.

snippet.text:
set w := β * c / Q
  set c₀ := round w
  set s₀ := w - c₀
  have hs₀ : |s₀| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_sub_round w
  set τn := fun n : ℤ => s₀ + β * (n - c) / Q
  have hsmall : ∀ n ∈ S, |β * (n - c) / Q| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hQ0, div_le_iff₀ hQ0]
    calc |β| * |(n : ℝ) - c| ≤ 1 * (q / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul hβ (hdist n hn) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 * Q := by linarith
  have hkey : ∀ n : ℤ, π * α * n = π * ((a * n + c₀ : ℤ) + τn n) / q := by
    intro n
    simp only [τn, s₀, w, hα]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

proof_context.conclusion: With `w = βc/Q`, `c₀ = round w`, `s₀ = w - c₀`, `τn n = s₀ + β(n-c)/Q`, proves `π α n = π((a n + c₀) + τn n)/q`.
